title: Shortness of Breath
diagnosis: Pulmonary Edema or Congestive Heart Failure until proven otherwise
correct_orders: Obtain electrocardiogram (ECG) to assess heart function and rule out acute coronary syndrome
Chest X-ray to evaluate lung fields, cardiac silhouette, and pleural effusions
Order: Order: time-sensitive interventions first; (oxygen, IV access, glucose check)
should_avoid: Starting a broad-spectrum antibiotic therapy without culture results

rationale.Starting a broad-spectrum antibiotic the: This should be avoided because it can lead to antibiotic resistance and unnecessary costs
rationale.Oxygen: The patient presents with shortness of breath which is a life-threatening symptom. Immediate administration of oxygen is crucial to stabilize the patient.
rationale.Order: Order: time-sensitive interventio: IV access and glucose check are also important for immediate stabilization of the patient.

physical_exam: Dyspneic, speaking in short phrases if severe
